info.name: True Fit - Consumer Discovery Recommendation API
Retrieve product recommendations for the shopper profile.

params.name: locale
params.description: Identifier specifying the locale to use when retrieving suggested brands or any type of sizes e.g. sizes, bra sizes, inseams or sleeve lengths. This attribute is only required when the store supports multiple locales. Use an ISO 639 language code followed by an ISO 3166 country code, e.g. en_US.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of products to return on a request. The current maximum limit is 24 products, and the default limit is 6.

params.name: s
params.description: Store Style IDs to exclude from Discovery Recommendations.

params.name: currentStyle
params.description: Store style ID of the product the user is currently viewing, if applicable.
